message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libvips && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"fuzz/smartcrop_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":11,"var":"data,size","code":"vips_image_new_from_buffer( data, size, \"\", NULL )","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are handed to libvips as an image buffer."},
{"step":2,"file":"libvips/iofuncs/image.c","function":"vips_image_new_from_buffer","line":2148,"var":"blob","code":"blob = vips_blob_new( NULL, buf, len );","note":"The input buffer is wrapped without copying, so downstream loaders read the original attacker bytes."},
{"step":3,"file":"libvips/foreign/exif.c","function":"vips__exif_parse","line":480,"var":"data,size","code":"vips_exif_load_data_without_fix( data, size )","note":"The EXIF blob attached to the image is parsed before smartcrop runs."},
{"step":4,"file":"libvips/foreign/exif.c","function":"vips_exif_load_data_without_fix","line":161,"var":"data","code":"exif_data_load_data( ed, data, length );","note":"libvips disables specification-fixing and forwards the raw EXIF bytes into libexif."},
{"step":5,"file":"libexif/exif-data.c","function":"exif_data_load_data","line":839,"var":"d_orig,ds","code":"if( !memcmp( d, ExifHeader, 6 ) ) ... exif_data_load_data_content( data, EXIF_IFD_0, d + 6, ds - 6, offset, 0 );","note":"The parser accepts the EXIF header and begins walking IFD0 entries from attacker-controlled offsets."},
{"step":6,"file":"libexif/exif-data.c","function":"exif_data_load_data_content","line":390,"var":"o","code":"o = exif_get_long( d + offset + 12 * i + 8, data->priv->order );","note":"A tag entry supplies a sub-IFD or thumbnail offset that is derived directly from the input."},
{"step":7,"file":"libexif/exif-data.c","function":"exif_data_load_data_content","line":467,"var":"o","code":"exif_data_load_data_content( data, EXIF_IFD_EXIF, d, ds, o, recursion_cost + level_cost(n) );","note":"The offset is recursively followed into a nested EXIF IFD, extending parsing into attacker-chosen structure."},
{"step":8,"file":"libexif/exif-data.c","function":"exif_data_load_data_entry","line":163,"var":"entry->data","code":"memcpy( entry->data, d + doff, s );","note":"Entry payload bytes are copied from the attacker buffer using the computed offset and size."},
{"step":9,"file":"libvips/foreign/exif.c","function":"vips__exif_parse","line":513,"var":"ed->data,ed->size","code":"vips_image_set_blob_copy( image, \"jpeg-thumbnail-data\", ed->data, ed->size );","note":"The parsed EXIF thumbnail is attached back to the image and later consumed by smartcrop-related processing."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p)
PY
